evidence_role: HeadDev feasibility evidence only; not independent confirmation

architecture.expert: unchanged Stage8 G1; two independently instantiated full networks

training.objective: mean SoftCE over respective target type; q=softmax(-FDE_k/1m)
training.carry: prepend epoch remainder to next epoch; final remainder preserved in last checkpoint; no shortened optimizer batches or discarded targets
training.checkpoint_selection: minimum respective-type entire HeadDev SoftCE; strict improvement and earliest ties

tiny.failed_tiny: STOP; no tuning or formal training

neutral.bicycle: all HeadTrain/HeadDev logits and probabilities bitwise R2; actual candidates checked before training and throughout final HeadDev

evaluation.minADE6_convention: ADE of minFDE-selected mode, unchanged historical protocol; independent min-ADE additionally reported as minADEOracle6
evaluation.oracle_for_hit_rank: lowest-index min-FDE candidate; stable descending probability ties

bootstrap.method: paired whole-scene cluster bootstrap; actor-weighted within sampled scenes
bootstrap.groups: all 10 required groups; same scene resamples
bootstrap.CI: percentile 2.5/97.5; feasibility screening only because HeadDev selects checkpoints

decision.GO: Vehicle<=-0.03m AND Pedestrian<=0m AND Bicycle bitwise identical AND Overall<0m AND all engineering audits PASS
decision.CONDITIONAL_GO: if not GO: Vehicle<0m AND Pedestrian<=+0.01m AND Bicycle bitwise identical AND Overall<0m AND all engineering audits PASS
decision.STOP: otherwise; no model changes or additional seed search
decision.NegativeTransferMitigated_YES: Vehicle delta<0m AND Pedestrian delta<=0m AND Bicycle exact AND engineering PASS
decision.NegativeTransferMitigated_PARTIAL: if not YES: Vehicle delta<0m AND Pedestrian delta<=+0.01m AND Bicycle exact AND engineering PASS
decision.ReadyStage10B: YES iff GO or CONDITIONAL_GO; recommendation only, stop for review in all cases

limitations: Hypothesis motivated by historical official VAL results
HeadDev selects expert checkpoints; bootstrap CI is not independent confirmation
Stage5A and R2 have historical training and checkpoint selection; not independent end-to-end validation
One predeclared seed per expert; Bicycle remains fully present but its small HeadDev count limits interpretation
No official VAL, no test, no automatic Stage10B
